hook: In the late thirteen hundreds, a cove on Oak Island experienced a massive saltwater intrusion, likely from human manipulation.
descricao: For over two centuries, treasure hunters have tried to unearth the secret of the Oak Island Money Pit. What do you believe is buried beneath the island?

versoes.rascunho: In 1795, a boy spotted a strange pit on an isolated island. What lay beneath it cost fortunes, lives, and centuries of obsession. Daniel McInnis began digging into the damp dirt. At ten feet down, he hit a solid layer of oak logs. He dug deeper. Every ten feet, another wooden platform blocked his path. Years later, excavators pushed down to ninety feet. But suddenly, rushed ocean water flooded the shaft, trapping their efforts. Someone had deliberately trapped the pit with sea tunnels. Near the shore, searchers found strange non-native coconut fibers hidden in the beach. Then, modern scientists tested core samples from the island swamp. Saltwater invaded that basin in the late thirteen hundreds. Analysis shows human manipulation altered the island long before the settlers came. Someone engineered an ocean cove over six hundred years ago. They dug deep into clay and slate to hide a secret forever. Modern machines still cannot reach the bottom. What were they protecting beneath the fog and mud before Columbus ever sailed? What do you think is down there?
